name: @cadfixer/auto-split
description: The Auto Split engine, run inside the geometry worker: the six deterministic renders a semantic request needs, the local matching of a semantic answer to a part's real geometry, and the editable suggestions that come out of it. Suggests; never mutates.
//exports: ./fixtures builds the human, vehicle and truck test models (and the scenarios that describe them) so unit, service and browser suites exercise the SAME geometry. Test-only: no production path imports it, and the production boundary scan checks that.
